name: verdandi-latency1r

provenance.tool: shell latency1r-window (shell/latency1r.rs court over the GDI surface appended to shell/win32.rs) + verify/latency1r.py
provenance.surface: shell/latency1r.rs court over the GDI window (StretchDIBits + DwmFlush, QPC) surface

validity_scope.certifies: render-start -> composited of the production render (T=8) and the single-thread reference over the sealed reference session on host DANIELDILLBERG, locked and uniform phase, 200 samples per cell over 4 frames

forbidden_interpretations: input-to-photon latency: input transport and panel scan-out need capture hardware
a comparison with LATENCY-0's or LATENCY-1's frame-ready -> composited, or with any emit p99 (different observables)
a render-speed claim: that is GAUNTLET-2's; here the render is one part of a render-inclusive present interval
that the locked or uniform regime is a real game loop under load (each is a declared phase model)
that absorption in the locked regime means faster rendering is useless (it is the refresh-coupled GDI present's property)
a single scalar: the propagation permille is on p50s; the p99s are reported beside it, never folded in
any other host, session, panel or window state; absolute us are host- and panel-specific
reading: LATENCY-1R, render-start -> composited, production (T=8) vs the single-thread reference, on host DANIELDILLBERG (refresh 13926 us, 200 samples per cell). locked: ABSORBED — render delta 2640 us, glass delta 2 us, 0 permille of the render headroom reached composited (p50s; the p99 total delta is -358 us, reported beside it). The production arm's frame-ready -> composited grew by 2559 us: the saved render time was spent waiting for the composition. uniform: PROPAGATES — render delta 2673 us, glass delta 3587 us, 1341 permille of the render headroom reached composited (p50s; the p99 total delta is 3110 us, reported beside it). A composed-GDI present is refresh-coupled (LATENCY-0), so absorption in the locked regime is a property of this present path, not evidence that faster rendering is useless; decoupling it is PRESENT-1's hypothesis. Within this apparatus only: never compared to LATENCY-0/LATENCY-1 or to any emit p99; not input-to-photon.
